title: Make completion checkpoint cut-key derivation explicitly pure
outcome: The cut-key derivation contract cannot perform store I/O while the completion checkpoint holds the SQLite writer slot.
acceptance: The atomic second-writer regression remains deterministic without teaching production callbacks to perform I/O
The key derivation API uses a pure immutable callback contract and its lock boundary is documented
disposal_reason: Pure refactor with no behavior: the cut-key callback has one internal production caller (key_for_cut) and the writer-slot boundary is already pinned by completion_checkpoint_holds_the_writer_slot_across_cut_selection_and_append. Pre-release rule: no ceremony from reviews.
